entries.20613188981b7ba9: This reportable segment centers on Mitsubishi Research Institute DCS Co., Ltd. and provides software development, operation and maintenance, and information processing and outsourcing services in the fields of finance, manufacturing, distribution, services, and education and culture. It also provides information processing services centered on the payroll and personnel service "PROSRV", and outsourcing and BPO for core systems using the Chiba Information Center. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥74,367 million.
entries.2ad11deb4e6c640a: This category develops systems for public-sector clients and payment areas in the finance and card fields. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥44,989 million.
entries.72931c75f12e9cb7: A comprehensive think tank that handles research and consulting on policy issues and IT services.
entries.991984a045a35770: This reportable segment, drawing on the policy and institutional knowledge and quantitative analysis and forecasting techniques it has built as a general think tank since its founding, conducts research and consulting for government agencies in the social and public fields and science and technology policy fields, and management and business strategy consulting and IT consulting for private-sector companies. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥47,090 million.
entries.cd158360b814d87c: This category provides information processing services and outsourcing and BPO for core systems. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥29,377 million.
